1.consolidated_definition: Pájaro de pequeño tamaño, cabeza, patas y pico negros, lomo, cola y alas, de color cenizo oscuro. Sternidae, Chlidonias nigra.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Bird of small size, with black head, legs, and beak, and dark ash-gray back, tail, and wings. Sternidae, Chlidonias nigra.
